title: 第1267章 紫火焚天草半步天仙紫火晶第1266章 一锅端
slug: 炼气期如履薄冰元婴期重拳出击
content_zh:
三百万里外，早已超出半步天仙的元神感应距离。
嘿，赚翻了！
李青元抬手一挥，各种资源飞出。
焚天紫火草、十余株一二阶仙药、数十块仙金，尽数展现在眼前。
又一株三阶仙药·紫火焚天草。
此药，乃是炼制大雷火真灵丹的三大主料之一。
十绝仙子炼化雷火焚苍域上一任天仙之主留下的阵法，尽得上一任天仙之主传承，天仙功法、阵法玉简、相应神通等。
这其中，还有一份大雷火真灵丹的丹方。
四阶丹药，炼体大丹，纵然天仙初期体修服用，亦是大补之物。
对雷属性、火属性修士而言，可助真仙巅峰、半步天仙感悟雷火真意、淬炼雷火真灵，增加一两成肉身冲击天仙的可能。
对李青元而言，作为雷火体修，更是量身定制。
半步天仙级，紫火金晶兽。
李青元放出重伤垂死的兽王。
十几万丈巨兽已是强弩之末，鳞甲崩裂，紫火护罩消散，能量核心暴露在外。
方才被赵星辰九星落日连续轰击，兽体崩裂大半，生机几近断绝。
他五指一握，五灾之力瞬间钻入兽王体魄。
天雷、赑风、阴火、禁制、罪业之力同时绞杀，五灾之力从兽王内部爆发，如蛆附骨，不可阻挡。
一声不甘怒吼中，兽王化作齑粉，十几万丈巨兽在五灾之力绞杀下，从内而外崩碎，紫色能量四散飞溢。
漫天紫火本源凝聚，化作一块一尺立方的紫火晶。
嗡！

一尺立方的紫火晶浮空而立，浓郁火之本源升腾，紫色火焰摇曳，方圆百丈虚空都在扭曲。
这块紫火晶与此前所得的真仙级紫火晶截然不同，晶体内部并非单纯的光影流转，而是有一簇实实在在的紫色火苗在燃烧。
这块紫火晶，好像不太对劲。
李青元面露沉吟：似乎多了某种奇特本源，内涵一缕紫火。
真仙境紫火晶，那一缕紫火只是虚火，犹如无根之木——有形无质，无法引燃。
而半步天仙紫火晶内含的紫火，似乎已是实体火苗——有形有质，可引燃、可炼化、可凝聚。
所有资源，收入空间，复制翻倍。
李青元咧嘴一笑：两块半步天仙紫火晶，哈哈哈，爽。
玄牝空间中，老赵已经凝炼出第二个真灵傀儡，开始炼化第三个。
姬鲲仍在闭关，冲击真仙中期，十二仙窍开始搭建若有若无的仙窍法轮虚影，开始一点一点凝实。
南明离火处于涅盘状态，本能在吞噬四周渡劫期紫火晶、真仙级紫火晶。
此外，二阶仙药·海心坤元火的本源已被吞噬炼化大半，橘红色火焰中紫意越来越浓。
看这样子，要不了多久南明离火便可彻底晋升为二阶仙火。
届时，有这两块半步天仙紫火晶相助，南明离火晋升三阶仙火的可能性，十拿九稳。
李青元收了资源，身形容貌变幻。
九转玄功与大品天仙决，加上通天建木仙道根基模拟万法，他的肉身、仙力、法则波动尽数改变，气息从人族修士变为火兽族修士。
进入此地的，一共也才三十八个真仙修士。
已经死了八个，或许其他争夺中，也有真仙修士陨落，但想来仍有二十多个。
血影道人这个马甲，也不能用了。
content_en:
Three million miles away, it is already beyond the half-step immortal soul sensing distance.
Hey, I made a lot of money!
Li Qingyuan raised his hand and waved, and various resources flew out.
Burning Sky Purple Fire Grass, more than a dozen first- and second-level elixirs, and dozens of pieces of immortal gold are all displayed in front of you.
Another third-level elixir, Purple Fire Burning Sky Grass.
This medicine is one of the three main ingredients for refining the Great Thunder Fire True Spirit Pill.
The Shijue Fairies refined the formations left by the previous Heavenly Immortal Master of the Thunder Fire Burning Cang Domain, and inherited all the Heavenly Immortal Master's inheritance, including the Heavenly Immortal Kung Fu, Formation Jade Slips, and corresponding magical powers.
Among them, there is also a recipe for the Great Thunder Fire True Spirit Pill.
A fourth-level elixir, a great body-refining elixir, even if taken by a heavenly being in his early stages of physical training, it would be a great tonic.
For monks with thunder and fire attributes, it can help peak true immortals and half-step immortals understand the true meaning of thunder and fire, temper the true spirit of thunder and fire, and increase the possibility of impacting heavenly immortals with one or two percent of their physical bodies.
For Li Qingyuan, as a thunder and fire body cultivator, it is even more tailor-made.
Half-step to the immortal level, a purple fire gold crystal beast.
Li Qingyuan released the seriously injured and dying Beast King.
The giant beast of more than 100,000 feet was at the end of its power, its scales cracked, the purple fire shield dissipated, and its energy core was exposed.
Just now, it was continuously bombarded by Zhao Xingchen's nine-star sunset. Most of the beast's body was shattered, and its vitality was almost cut off.
He clenched his five fingers, and the power of the five disasters instantly penetrated into the Beast King's body.
The power of heavenly thunder, wind, yin fire, prohibition, and sinful karma strangled at the same time. The power of the five disasters erupted from the inside of the beast king, like maggots attached to the bones, unstoppable.
With an unwilling roar, the beast king turned into powder. The giant beast of more than ten thousand feet was strangled by the power of the five disasters, shattered from the inside out, and purple energy scattered in all directions.
The source of the purple fire all over the sky condensed and turned into a one-foot-cubic purple fire crystal.
Buzz!
A one-foot-cubic purple fire crystal floated in the air, the source of rich fire rose, the purple flames swayed, and the void within a hundred feet radius was distorted.
This piece of Purple Fire Crystal is completely different from the True Immortal Grade Purple Fire Crystal obtained before. There is not a simple flow of light and shadow inside the crystal, but a cluster of real purple flames burning.
There seems to be something wrong with this purple fire crystal.
Li Qingyuan looked thoughtful and said: It seems to have some kind of strange origin, a wisp of purple fire within it.
True Fairyland Purple Fire Crystal, that wisp of purple fire is just a virtual fire, like a rootless tree - tangible and insubstantial, unable to ignite.
The purple fire contained in the Half-Step Celestial Purple Fire Crystal seems to be a physical flame - tangible and qualitative, which can be ignited, refined, and condensed.
All resources, income space, and copying are doubled.
Li Qingyuan grinned: Two half-step fairy purple fire crystals, hahaha, so cool.
In the mysterious female space, Lao Zhao has condensed the second true spirit puppet and started to refine the third one.
Ji Kun is still in seclusion, in the middle stage of impacting the true immortal, and the twelve immortal orifices begin to build the faint shadow of the immortal orifice Falun, which begins to solidify little by little.
Nanming Lihuo is in a state of nirvana, and his instinct is to devour the surrounding Tribulation Stage Purple Fire Crystals and True Immortal Level Purple Fire Crystals.
In addition, most of the origin of the second-level elixir Haixinkun Yuanhuo has been devoured and refined, and the purple meaning in the orange-red flames is getting stronger and stronger.
Looking at it like this, it won't be long before Nanming Lihuo can be completely promoted to the second level Immortal Fire.
By then, with the help of these two half-step immortal purple fire crystals, the possibility of Nanming Lihuo being promoted to the third level of immortal fire is almost certain.
Li Qingyuan collected the resources, and his body and appearance changed.
With the help of the Nine Revolutions Mysterious Technique and the Great Immortal Technique, as well as the Tongtian Jianmu Immortal Dao foundation that simulates all kinds of methods, his body, immortal power, and law fluctuations all changed, and his aura changed from a human monk to a fire beast monk.
There are only thirty-eight True Immortal cultivators who have entered this place.
Eight have died, and perhaps some True Immortal cultivators have also died in other battles, but I think there are still more than twenty.
The vest of Blood Shadow Taoist can no longer be used.
